title: A Lorentz-Covariant Substrate Field Theory: Action, Projection, and Cross-Modal Recovery Subtitle: Part I of the Quantum Substrate Dynamics Series
content:

The result is a compact Lorentz-covariant Lagrangian base for systematically developing QSD.
